india_trends.title: FPIs emerge as biggest sellers among anchor investors in IPOs' 30-day window: Sebi study
india_trends.summary: Foreign portfolio investors led anchor investor selling in IPOs. Heavy anchor exits around the 30-day unlock window pressured stock prices. Smaller IPOs experienced higher anchor investor exits and selling intensity. Anchor investors continued selling beyond prescribed lock-in periods significantly.

india_trends.title: SEBI plans SME IPO route for companies valued up to ₹5,000 crore
india_trends.summary: Regulator weighs to raise post-issue paid-up capital limit for SME listings to ₹100 crore from ₹25 crore, while easing minimum application size, market-making norms and underwriting norms to improve participation in the segment

india_trends.title: Promoters pare stakes in UltraTech, Thyrocare through block deals
india_trends.summary: Pilani Investment sold a 0.85 per cent stake in UltraTech Cement for Rs 2,896.3 crore, while Thyrocare promoter Docon Technologies sold a 9.9 per cent stake.

india_trends.title: Sebi proposes colour-coded risk meter for bonds
india_trends.summary: Sebi wants credit ratings mapped to six colour-coded risk levels to make debt securities easier for investors to assess.

india_trends.title: Bill Ackman adds Netflix, Visa & Mastercard in biggest portfolio shake-up in years
india_trends.summary: Investor Bill Ackman has disclosed significant portfolio changes, adding Netflix and other companies. His funds acquired stakes in Alcon, Intercontinental Exchange, and S&P Global. Ackman also added Microsoft to his portfolio earlier this year.

india_trends.title: FPIs lead the exit as anchor investors after IPO lock-ins end: Sebi study
india_trends.summary: A Sebi study of 242 IPOs shows anchor investors sell gradually after lock-ins lift, with FPIs exiting nearly twice as fast as mutual funds by year-end. Smaller IPOs and heavy first-unlock selling were linked to sharper price declines.

india_trends.title: Multibagger Mercury EV-Tech stock to be in focus on Friday after June quarter results
india_trends.summary: Mercury EV-Tech reported a 47.9% YoY revenue increase to ₹33.38 crore for Q1FY27. EBITDA rose 38.1% YoY to ₹2.62 crore, but net profit decreased by 4.2% to ₹1.56 crore, affected by rising expenses. The stock declined 74% from its 2024 high.

india_trends.title: Indian Hotels, Tata Steel among key picks in Tata group for Jefferies
india_trends.summary: Jefferies favours Indian Hotels, Tata Consumer, Tata Steel and Voltas, while remaining cautious on TCS, Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles and Tata Power

india_trends.title: Tata Motors reassures investors after N Chandrasekaran's exit: ‘We will remain fully focused’
india_trends.summary: The automaker recently outlined plans to invest 330 billion to 350 billion rupees ($3.46 billion-$3.67 billion) in its passenger and electric vehicle businesses between FY26 and FY30.

india_trends.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
india_trends.summary: Sensex gained 114 points while Nifty fell over 40 points on expiry day, reflecting divergent benchmark moves. Softer inflation supported sentiment, but elevated crude prices and geopolitical risks kept investors cautious, with Nifty remaining rangebound between key technical levels.

india_trends.title: Birkenstock shares pop 20% to 3-week high after strong fiscal Q3; company raises annual revenue forecast
india_trends.summary: Shares of Birkenstock soared 20% to $43.90 after positive Q3 results, reporting 13% revenue growth. The company raised its full-year sales forecast and benefited from strong demand for its footwear. Despite a 15% decline in net profit, adjusted figures improved sharply.

india_trends.title: Sebi seeks public comments on review of Accredited Investor framework
india_trends.summary: SEBI has proposed revamping Accredited Investor rules by adding securities-market assets as an eligibility criterion, simplifying accreditation and expanding deemed eligibility. The changes could increase eligible investors to nearly 4 lakh and ease access to alternative investment products.

india_trends.title: Honasa bets on younger brands, new categories after Q1 profit doubles
india_trends.summary: Mamaearth parent Honasa Consumer plans to scale younger brands and enter fragrance after profit more than doubled in Q1FY27

india_trends.title: Bank of Baroda raises $700 million in first overseas bond issue since 2019
india_trends.summary: Bank of Baroda raised $700 million through three-year and five-year dollar bonds, marking its first overseas issue in over seven years. Strong investor demand helped tighten pricing, with proceeds aimed at leveraging RBI’s special swap window.
